name: After Play
storyline:
Thirteen children gathered to celebrate a birthday at an indoor playground known as Kinderparadies. What was supposed to be a joyful celebration turned into a horrifying tragedy.

Years later, the abandoned playground holds dark secrets behind its colorful attractions, empty corridors, and forgotten play areas. The player takes on the role of a night security guard tasked with monitoring the facility. But as the night progresses, strange anomalies begin to appear, and the seemingly innocent playground reveals disturbing traces of its past.

Through exploration, mysterious newspaper articles, and hidden clues, the player gradually uncovers what really happened during the birthday celebration.
summary:
After Play is a first-person horror game set inside an abandoned indoor children's playground. The player takes on the role of a night security guard investigating mysterious events and disturbing secrets hidden within the facility.

During the night, the player must observe the environment, discover anomalies, explore different areas of the playground, and collect clues to uncover the truth behind its dark past. An additional asymmetric multiplayer mode allows a second player to control the timing and activation of anomalies through a web browser, while the first player explores the playground.
